symbols.name: PRIVATE_KEY_CONTENT
symbols.doc:
Risk flagging runs inside the scan traversal because the bytes are already in
hand. Every downstream consumer — bundling, the wiki, the agent's write
approval prompt — inherits the result without paying for another pass.

The bias throughout is toward precision over recall. A flag on ordinary source
trains the reader to ignore flags, which is worse than missing one.

symbols.name: calculateShannonEntropy
symbols.doc:
Calculates the standard Shannon entropy of a string:
H(X) = -sum(P(x_i) * log2(P(x_i)))
Returns value in bits per character (0.0 to ~8.0 for byte/ASCII range).

symbols.name: calculateMetricEntropy
symbols.doc:
Normalizes Shannon entropy against the theoretical maximum for the given string length
or character alphabet.
